HomePage.heroDesc: BilimAi Learn Lang — teachers build vocabulary themes, students play voice games to learn a new language. No registration needed to play!
HomePage.howStep1Desc: Signs up and creates a topic for the lesson — like "Animals" or "Food". AI can add 10 words in one click.
HomePage.howStep2Desc: Sends the game link to the class. Students can play without registration — from phone or computer.
HomePage.howStep3Desc: Press the mic, say the word correctly — earn points. Text input mode also available. Results shown at the end.
HomePage.forWhoTeacherDesc: Create vocabulary themes and share links with your class. AI automatically generates word lists.
HomePage.forWhoTeacherF3: Unique game link for each theme
HomePage.forWhoStudentDesc: No registration needed. Open the link from your teacher and say words out loud to earn points.
HomePage.feat1Desc: Web Speech API checks your pronunciation. Say it right — earn a point.
HomePage.feat2Desc: Gemini AI suggests 10 words per topic automatically. Get your free key easily.
HomePage.feat3Desc: No-login play, class sharing links, team mode — all completely free.
HomePage.feat4Desc: Interface in 3 languages. Vocabulary can be in any language: English, Russian, Turkish and more.
HomePage.publicGamesDesc: Play without registration — open the link directly
HomePage.ctaDesc: If you're a teacher — create a theme. If you're a student — just play. All free!
